4-b.decision_correctness_justification: Three processing steps: (1) timestamp-based interpolation of motion energy onto imaging frame times using np.interp, (2) 10-frame binning via mean_bin_1d, (3) per-session rank-based equal-frequency 5-bin discretization. 4-c.code_correctness_justification: The code correctly implements rank-based discretization in equal_frequency_bins(): argsort to get order, compute ranks, assign bins as (ranks * n_bins) // n.
